info.title: HisaabAI Retail Intelligence
info.description: Retail decision support for Pakistani general stores (CYE 2026, Track 3)

get.description: The store's name, location and data window, so the app never hard-codes them.
Top 3 actions for today, each with evidence and a next step (HOME-01).
Is the shop open? What should be in the galla now, and today's figures so far.

post.description: Open the day with the counted galla. A difference from the records is booked.
Close the day with the counted galla. Returns the day's summary and what tomorrow holds.

get.description: Past days: opening and closing counts, galla differences, and each day's figures.

schema.title: Response Get History Api Day History Get

post.description: Kharcha paid from the galla: rent, bijli, salary, transport, or money taken home or banked.

get.description: Sales, gross profit, stock, khata, payables and cash for a period, with the change vs the period before (HOME-02).
Products with days of cover, risk and the reason, plus counts for the filter chips (INV-01, INV-02).
One product: health, price history, recent stock movements and the last 30 days' sales.

patch.description: Change the shelf price. A price-history row is recorded so the margin check sees it.

post.description: Record stock received or written off. Stock can never go below zero.
'I have Rs 50,000. What should I buy today and why?' Whole packs, never over budget (REC-01..04).
Forecast for a product, a category or the whole store, compared with two baselines on held-out days (FC-01..03).

get.description: Margin squeezes (PROF-01) and dead stock (INV-03), with evidence.
Khata balances, aging by days past due, and Safe Mark scores with reasons (CRED-01).
Every khata customer, most recently active first, for the picker at the counter.

schema.title: Response List Customers Api Credit Customers Get

post.description: Open a new khata.

get.description: One customer's khata page with a running balance and the items bought on each udhaar.

post.description: 'Udhaar dun?' Yes, careful or no for this customer and amount, with the reasons.

Write udhaar in the khata: who, which items, at what price, and when it is due.

Items are sold from stock at the shelf price and linked to the khata line. Returns a
receipt draft to show the customer; nothing is sent anywhere.

Record a repayment (wasooli) and how it was paid. It cannot be more than the customer owes.

Only cash goes into the galla; Easypaisa, JazzCash and bank payments do not.

get.description: What the shop owes each distributor: overdue, due soon, and orders still on the way.
Day-by-day cash for the next week from today's real cash in hand, with every assumption listed (CASH-01).
Distributors with their route days, what is owed, and how much the shop can safely order.

post.description: What to order from this distributor within the budget, in whole packs, with reasons.
Save the order given to the booker. Returns the order text to show on screen; nothing is sent.

schema.title: Response List Orders Api Orders Get

post.description: Save a whole-shop budget plan as one pending order per distributor (all or nothing, within budget).
Maal aaya: stock in at the bill price, a supplier bill created, price changes flagged.
Pay a distributor. Clears the oldest bills first. Cash payments come out of the galla.

get.description: The counting sheet for one shelf (category): what the records expect on it.

post.description: Save a count. Stock is set to what was counted; a shortfall is booked as loss or as unrecorded sales.

schema.title: Response History Api Stock Count History Get

get.description: Six months of sales, profit after costs, credit, supplier bills and record keeping, for a lender.

post.description: Answer a question in English or Roman Urdu using only allow-listed, read-only tools (COP-01..04).

get.description: Is voice ready: has the owner allowed online AI, and is one configured? (Never the keys.)

patch.description: The owner's yes or no to sending recordings to an online AI to be understood.

post.description:
What was said, and what HisaabAI thinks should be written. Nothing is saved to the books yet.

A question ("Imran ka kitna baqi hai?") is answered straight away by the copilot instead.
The shopkeeper checked it: write the udhaar, wasooli or kharcha, linked to the recording.
"Rehne dein": nothing is written. The capture is kept as set aside.

schema.title: Response Discard Api Voice Captures  Capture Id  Discard Post

get.description: Play back what the shopkeeper said for this entry.
Recent voice entries and how often they were saved without a correction (real use, not simulated).

post.description: Step 1: check every row and show problems by row number. Nothing is saved yet (DATA-02).
Step 2: save the valid rows from the preview, all or nothing.

get.description: A sample CSV with the right columns.

post.description: Rebuild the demo store from the fixed seed (DATA-01). Needs the X-Demo-Key header.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description: The recording (WAV preferred), up to 30 seconds.

answer_language.title: Answer Language
answer_language.description: For questions: the answer's language ('urdu' = Urdu script, for read-aloud).

cash_loans_pkr.title: Cash Loans Pkr
cash_loans_pkr.description: Naqad udhaar: cash handed to customers from the galla.

treat_short_as.title: Treat Short As
treat_short_as.description: 'sales' books a shortfall as cash sales not written down.

sold_since_last_count.title: Sold Since Last Count
sold_since_last_count.description: From the counts: last count + received - this count.

safe_amount_pkr.title: Safe Amount Pkr
safe_amount_pkr.description: How much more credit fits in the limit. 0 if a bill is over 30 days late.

score.title: Score
score.description: How close the spoken name is, 0 to 1.

safe_mark_score.title: Safe Mark Score
safe_mark_score.description: 0-100. Starts at 100; each lost point has a listed reason.

wasooli_digital_pkr.title: Wasooli Digital Pkr
wasooli_digital_pkr.description: Easypaisa, JazzCash and bank. Not in the galla.

supplier_payments_pkr.title: Supplier Payments Pkr
supplier_payments_pkr.description: Paid to distributors in cash from the galla.

expenses_pkr.title: Expenses Pkr
expenses_pkr.description: Running costs: rent, bijli, salaries, transport, general.

withdrawals_pkr.title: Withdrawals Pkr
withdrawals_pkr.description: Money taken home or deposited in the bank. Not a cost.

cash_loans_pkr.title: Cash Loans Pkr
cash_loans_pkr.description: Naqad udhaar: cash lent from the galla. Part of udhaar given.

gross_profit_pkr.title: Gross Profit Pkr
gross_profit_pkr.description: Sales minus the cost of the items sold.

tomorrow.description: After the day is closed: what tomorrow holds.
After the day is closed: what tomorrow holds.

words.title: Words
words.description: The words for this item, e.g. 'do kilo cheeni'.

qty_heard.title: Qty Heard
qty_heard.description: False when no quantity was said and 1 was filled in.

qty_said.title: Qty Said
qty_said.description: The words the quantity came from, e.g. 'do kilo'.

match.description: Preselected only when one product clearly fits.

options.title: Options
options.description: Products that fit, best first; ties go to what sells most.

out_of_stock_on_order_count.title: Out Of Stock On Order Count

method.title: Method
method.description: How a repayment was made. Empty for udhaar.

items.title: Items
items.description: What was bought on this udhaar, when known.

cash_loan.title: Cash Loan
cash_loan.description: Cash handed over from the galla (naqad udhaar).

has_recording.title: Has Recording
has_recording.description: The voice recording is kept and can be played back.

MessageDraft.title: MessageDraft
MessageDraft.description: A message the shopkeeper can read out, show, or copy. HisaabAI never sends it.

wape_pct.title: Wape Pct
wape_pct.description: Average daily error, as % of units sold

total_error_pct.title: Total Error Pct
total_error_pct.description: Error on the total units over the test window

spoken_name.title: Spoken Name
spoken_name.description: The name as heard, in Roman letters.

match.description: The khata picked for the shopkeeper, only when the match is clear.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Close khatas to choose from, best first.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: One pending order per distributor; each arrives through Maal aaya.

budget_pkr.title: Budget Pkr
budget_pkr.description: The plan's budget; the orders together never cost more.

selling_price.title: Selling Price
selling_price.description: Shelf price; prices never come from speech.

score.title: Score
score.description: How well it fits the words said, 0 to about 1.

qty.title: Qty
qty.description: The quantity said, in this product's own unit (e.g. '5 kilo atta' = 1 bag of 5 kg).

unit_cost.title: Unit Cost
unit_cost.description: Price per unit on the distributor's bill.

save_draft.title: Save Draft
save_draft.description: Also save the plan as a draft purchase plan

bill_due_date.title: Bill Due Date
bill_due_date.description: When a new order's bill would be due: delivery + credit days.

lowest_cash_pkr.title: Lowest Cash Pkr
lowest_cash_pkr.description: Lowest expected cash in the week after the bill is due.

quantity_change.title: Quantity Change
quantity_change.description: Positive for stock received, negative for damage or loss

budget.description: The most the galla can bear for an order from this distributor.

usual_order_pkr.title: Usual Order Pkr
usual_order_pkr.description: Average bill per order from them in the last 90 days.

suggested_budget_pkr.title: Suggested Budget Pkr
suggested_budget_pkr.description: The galla limit, capped at 1.5x the usual order.

extra_amount.title: Extra Amount
extra_amount.description: Money or items not in the catalogue.

cash_from_galla.title: Cash From Galla
cash_from_galla.description: The extra amount was cash handed over from the galla (naqad udhaar).

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Udhaar: the amount besides the items (may be 0 with items).

items.title: Items
items.description: Udhaar of goods, sold at shelf price.

new_customer_name.title: New Customer Name
new_customer_name.description: Open a new khata with this name.

answered.title: Answered
answered.description: Questions asked by voice and answered.

VoiceLog.title: VoiceLog
VoiceLog.description: Real usage, not simulated: how often voice entries were saved without a correction.

intent.title: Intent
intent.description: Empty when it was not clear. 'question': answered, nothing written.

question.title: Question
question.description: Intent 'question': what was asked, as sent to the copilot.

answer.description: Intent 'question': the copilot's answer (numbers only from its tools).

amount_pkr.title: Amount Pkr
amount_pkr.description: Only an amount that was really said; empty otherwise.

amount_heard.title: Amount Heard
amount_heard.description: The words the amount came from, e.g. 'paanch hazaar'.

extra_amount_pkr.title: Extra Amount Pkr
extra_amount_pkr.description: Udhaar: amount besides the items (cash said with them). Without items, the amount.

items.title: Items
items.description: Udhaar of goods: the items heard.

cash_from_galla.title: Cash From Galla
cash_from_galla.description: Udhaar: cash handed over from the galla (naqad), not goods.

cash_from_galla_heard.title: Cash From Galla Heard
cash_from_galla_heard.description: True if 'cash' or 'saamaan' was actually said.

due_date.title: Due Date
due_date.description: Return date, only if one was said.

usual_due_date.title: Usual Due Date
usual_due_date.description: The return date from the shop's usual credit term.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Plain notes on how it was understood (e.g. offline, amount not heard).

VoiceProposal.title: VoiceProposal
VoiceProposal.description: What HisaabAI understood. Nothing is saved until the shopkeeper confirms.

edited.title: Edited
edited.description: The shopkeeper changed something HisaabAI understood.

cloud_allowed.title: Cloud Allowed
cloud_allowed.description: The owner agreed to send recordings to a cloud AI to be understood.

cloud_available.title: Cloud Available
cloud_available.description: A cloud AI is configured (keys are never returned).
